name: Mountain Apple Computers
summary: Small dialup ISP in Penrith (NSW) run by Mountain Apple Computers (Mountain Apple Pty Ltd), alongside Apple Macintosh/PC retail and graphic prepress support; established 1993; mac.com.au live from ~1998 (Wayback); the domain was later taken up by Apple Inc.

events.details: Existing retail computer business Mountain Apple Computers (Mountain Apple Pty Ltd) in Penrith NSW, established 1993, began offering dialup ISP services (mac.com.au) by 1997.
ISP subsequently defunct; the mac.com.au domain was later held by Apple Inc.
